name: dumbbell full front raise catch
description: A single-arm full-range front raise, bringing one dumbbell from the side of the thigh to overhead under control.
instructions: Stand tall with one light dumbbell at your side and your free hand relaxed.
Keep your trunk steady and raise the dumbbell forward in an arc toward overhead.
Control the dumbbell at the top without leaning back.
Lower it slowly along the same path, then switch arms after the set.
